104                put(Items.ORBITAL_FUSION_LAMP, new BaseInstallableItemEffect(Items.ORBITAL_FUSION_LAMP) {
105                        public void apply(Industry industry) {
106                                Industry farming = getFarming(industry);
107                                if (farming != null && FUSION_LAMP_FARMING_BONUS > 0) {
108                                        if (farming.isFunctional()) {
109                                                farming.getSupplyBonusFromOther().modifyFlat(spec.getId(), FUSION_LAMP_FARMING_BONUS,
110                                                                Misc.ucFirst(spec.getName().toLowerCase()) + " (" + industry.getCurrentName() + ")");
111                                        } else {
112                                                farming.getSupplyBonusFromOther().unmodifyFlat(spec.getId());
113                                        }
114                                }
115                                if (industry instanceof BaseIndustry) {
116                                        BaseIndustry b = (BaseIndustry) industry;
117                                        b.demand(9, Commodities.VOLATILES, FUSION_LAMP_VOLATILES, Misc.ucFirst(spec.getName().toLowerCase()));
118                                        
119                                        MemoryAPI memory = getLampMemory(industry);
120                                        float h = getShortageHazard(industry);
121                                        if (h > 0) {
122                                                industry.getMarket().getHazard().modifyFlat(spec.getId(), h, 
123                                                                Misc.ucFirst(spec.getName().toLowerCase()) + " volatiles shortage");
124                                                if (memory != null) {
125                                                        // so that FusionLampEntityPlugin knows to flicker during a shortage
126                                                        memory.set(FusionLampEntityPlugin.VOLATILES_SHORTAGE_KEY, h / FUSION_LAMP_SHORTAGE_HAZARD);
127                                                }
128                                        }
129                                }
130                                for (String id : FUSION_LAMP_CONDITIONS) {
131                                        industry.getMarket().suppressCondition(id);
132                                }
133                        }
134                        public void unapply(Industry industry) {
135                                Industry farming = getFarming(industry);
136                                if (farming != null && FUSION_LAMP_FARMING_BONUS > 0) {
137                                        farming.getSupplyBonusFromOther().unmodifyFlat(spec.getId());
138                                }
139                                if (industry instanceof BaseIndustry) {
140                                        BaseIndustry b = (BaseIndustry) industry;
141                                        b.demand(9, Commodities.VOLATILES, 0, null);
142                                        industry.getMarket().getHazard().unmodifyFlat(spec.getId());
143                                        MemoryAPI memory = getLampMemory(industry);
144                                        if (memory != null) {
145                                                memory.unset(FusionLampEntityPlugin.VOLATILES_SHORTAGE_KEY);
146                                        }
147                                }
148                                for (String id : FUSION_LAMP_CONDITIONS) {
149                                        industry.getMarket().unsuppressCondition(id);
150                                }
151                        }
152                        protected MemoryAPI getLampMemory(Industry industry) {
153                                if (industry instanceof PopulationAndInfrastructure) {
154                                        PopulationAndInfrastructure b = (PopulationAndInfrastructure) industry;
155                                        if (b.lamp != null) {
156                                                return b.lamp.getMemoryWithoutUpdate();
157                                        }
158                                }
159                                return null;
160                        }
161                        protected float getShortageHazard(Industry industry) {
162                                int volatilesDemand = industry.getDemand(Commodities.VOLATILES).getQuantity().getModifiedInt();
163                                if (volatilesDemand <= 0 || FUSION_LAMP_SHORTAGE_HAZARD <= 0) return 0f;
164                                float v = industry.getMarket().getCommodityData(Commodities.VOLATILES).getAvailable();
165                                float f = 1f - v / (float) volatilesDemand;
166                                float h = Math.round(f * FUSION_LAMP_SHORTAGE_HAZARD * 100f) / 100f;
167                                if (h > 0) {
168                                        industry.getMarket().getHazard().modifyFlat(spec.getId(), h, 
169                                                        Misc.ucFirst(spec.getName().toLowerCase()) + " volatiles shortage");
170                                }
171                                return h;
172                        }
173                        protected Industry getFarming(Industry industry) {
174                                String farmingId = Industries.FARMING;
175                                Industry farming = industry.getMarket().getIndustry(farmingId);
176                                if (farming == null) {
177                                        farmingId = Industries.AQUACULTURE;
178                                        farming = industry.getMarket().getIndustry(farmingId);
179                                }
180                                return farming;
181                        }
182                        protected void addItemDescriptionImpl(Industry industry, TooltipMakerAPI text, SpecialItemData data,
183                                                                                                  InstallableItemDescriptionMode mode, String pre, float pad) {
184//                              List<String> conds = new ArrayList<String>();
185//                              for (String id : FUSION_LAMP_CONDITIONS) {
186//                                      MarketConditionSpecAPI mc = Global.getSettings().getMarketConditionSpec(id);
187//                                      conds.add(mc.getName());
188//                              }
189//                              text.addPara(pre + "Counters the effects of " + Misc.getAndJoined(conds) + ". Increases heat on non-cold planets. " +  
190//                                              "Adds demand for %s units of volatiles.",
191//                                              pad, Misc.getHighlightColor(), 
192//                                              "" + FUSION_LAMP_VOLATILES);
193                                text.addPara(pre + "Increases heat on non-cold planets. " +  
194                                                "Adds demand for %s units of volatiles.",
195                                                pad, Misc.getHighlightColor(), 
196                                                "" + FUSION_LAMP_VOLATILES);                            
197                        }

201                        }

204                                List<String> conds = new ArrayList<String>();
205                                for (String id : FUSION_LAMP_CONDITIONS) {
206                                        MarketConditionSpecAPI mc = Global.getSettings().getMarketConditionSpec(id);
207                                        conds.add(mc.getName().toLowerCase());

211                        @Override
212                        public Set<String> getConditionsRelatedToRequirements(Industry industry) {
213                                Set<String> list = super.getConditionsRelatedToRequirements(industry);
214                                list.addAll(FUSION_LAMP_CONDITIONS);
215                                list.add(Conditions.HOT);
216                                list.add(Conditions.VERY_HOT);
217                                return list;
218                        }

305                                        if (!list.isEmpty()) {

560                        protected boolean hasShortage(Industry industry) {
561                                //if (true) return false;

564                                float f = 1f - v / (float) transplutonicsDemand;
565                                return f > 0;
566                        }
